milestones.task: till dirt into farmland with hoe
milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_least(kind='block', object='farmland', min_count=1) because tilling dirt with a hoe converts the block to farmland. This directly verifies the block state change occurred. The bounding box covers all 5 dirt block positions (x∈[-1,1], z∈[2,3] at y=-1 relative to spawn) with ±2 padding in XZ and ±1 in Y for tolerance. Initially all blocks are dirt, so this rule cannot be satisfied until the player actually tills at least one block.
